#### Thika Main Campus Library

Thika Main Campus Library has an ambiance that is conducive for learning and study. Access to information is easy and all titles are easily retrievable. The library is well ventilated with all sections are well defined and labeled with a sitting capacity of the library is 1,000 users.

Services Offered

  1. Borrowing and lending Services.
  2. Current awareness Services.
  3. Inter-Library loan Services.
  4. Access to online Services.
  5. User Education Services.

Service Hours: Physical Library

Monday to Friday: 8.00 AM – 10.00 PM

Saturday: 9.00 AM – 5.00 PM

Sunday: 10.00 AM – 4.00 PM

Public Holidays: CLOSED

Digital Library

The Digital Library is operational 24/7

Books Allowed for Borrowing

Undergraduate: Up to 4 books for 14 days

Postgraduate: Up to 4 books for 30 days

Staff: Up to 4 books for 30 days

NOTE: Books are renewable once online via the online catalogue at https://opac.mku.ac.ke

Access to Information Resources

Our databases include information resources available in all our libraries and include print and electronic resources, and institutional repository.

E-RESOURCES

Online Journals, E-books, Institutional Repository and Databases can be accessed by clicking on the UNIVERSITY LIBRARY web page, followed by the Information Board and then by clicking on the icon ‘E-resources’.

INSTITUTIONAL REPOSITORY (IR)

Post graduate projects, theses and dissertations are access through the UNIVERSITY LIBRARY web page, followed by the Information Board and then by clicking on the icon ‘Institutional Repository’.

PRINT INFORMATION RESOURCES

The information resources are made accessible online through the Egerton University Home Page, on which you can find the EGERTON PORTAL. Click on the Library Catalogue icon for print information resources.

## JKUAT Karen Campus Library

The Library is dedicated to supporting the University’s mission of excellence in teaching, learning, and research. It provides comprehensive collections that give students and faculty access to the essential resources and information required for education, scholarship, and research. Located in a serene environment, the Library offers a space free from distractions, enhancing the learning experience for all users. The Campus Library is led by Janet, Chief Librarian, and supported by a professional team committed to delivering high-quality services to students and faculty.

## Library Services & Systems

The JKUAT Karen Library has automated its operations using the KOHA Integrated Library Management System , supporting the University’s mission to provide quality access to materials and services. The Library offers subject-based information services, including Science Information Services, Social Science Information Services, and Technology Information Services.

Organization and Access to Information Resources

Library information resources are organized using the Library of Congress Classification Scheme (LCCS) using the latest version of Anglo-American Cataloguing Rules (AACR2). The library’s Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) is web-based, thus enabling access by all via the University website.

ICT Infrastructure

The library is automated using the KOHA library management system. The system has both library user and staff interfaces integrated for efficient and effective services and operations.

The range of e-materials & services available in the library include:

Books: Printed Materials e.g. fiction, non-fiction and references

E-journals: Local and International

Kindles and Headphones

E-Books

Databases: Social Sciences, Business and Economics, Education Pure and Applied sciences, Information sciences.

Library materials can be accessed online through TRACpac, the online catalogue for Alberta's regional library systems. With your library card you can place holds on material or renew them from home or at the Library.  You can use the TRACpac Login at the top of this page to quickly access the catalogue.  For more search options, go directly to the TRACpac catalogue at www.tracpac.ab.ca

What can you do on TRACpac?

  * Place holds on items in the catalogue and have them sent to Strathmore Municipal Library for you to pick up.
  * Look at your account and see what you have checked out.
  * Renew your items.
  * See what items you have on hold.
  * Read book reviews and summaries and find other titles in a series.
  * Explore links to other resources.

How do I check my library account?
First, access the catalogue at http://www.tracpac.ab.ca/ and click on the "Log in" at the top right of the screen.

Enter the barcode number from your library card and and enter your PIN (usually the last 4 digits of your home telephone number).

The Library provides a wide range of authoritative and up-to-date information resources to support all academic programs offered by Mount Kenya University and for personal study.

Library Collection

The library’s collection is based on the university’s course offerings, and it is regularly updated. The total stock is 2168 print volumes and thousands of e-journals and eBooks. Resources for information are diverse, current, and pertinent. Mount Kenya University Meru Campus serves all upper Eastern Region of Kenya that covers a geographical scope of five (5) counties. These counties are Isiolo, Marsabit, Samburu, Meru and Tharaka-Nithi. The Library provides a wide range of authoritative and up-to-date information resources to support all academic programs offered by Mount Kenya University and for personal study.

Library Services

The library was founded with the goal of promoting and upholding a broad range of high-quality services that complement the University’s Vision and Mission. Among them are;

  1. Digital Library services
  2. User Services
  3. Reference and information services
  4. Circulation services
  5. Current Awareness services
  6. Information literacy service

Library Space

The library has a seating capacity of 80 comprising of the reading area and e-learning section. Its surroundings provide a favorable environment for learning and studying. The information hub is simple to use, and the stack area makes all titles accessible. The library is well ventilated with all sections well defined and labeled.
